description: Outline Application (Scale and Layout Only) for the front, side, rear and loft extension of the house at 147 Eastcote Lane conversion to form 6 self contained flats. All matters reserved save for Scale and Layout.
decision_conditions: <p>The proposal, by reason of the layout and placement of windows in the western flank wall would give rise to direct and perceived overlooking and loss of privacy to No. 149 Eastcote Lane, to the detriment of their residential amenities. The proposal would therefore be contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), and Policy GR1 of the Harrow&nbsp; Local Plan (2021 - 2041) and the Supplementary Planning Document; Residential Design Guide (2010).</p>

<p>The applicant has failed to provide sufficient information to demonstrate how it would achieve the statutory minimum 10% Biodiversity Net Gain (BNG), as required by the Environment Act 2021. In the absence of this information, the Local Planning Authority cannot be satisfied that the development would not result in a net loss of biodiversity or that it would deliver the required net gain. The proposal is therefore contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024),&nbsp;Policy G6 of the London Plan (2021), and Policy G13 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2024).</p>

The proposed development would result in poor quality accommodation that would not be fit for purpose due to flat layouts resulting in poor natural ventilation and the potential for overheating, poor availability of outlook,&nbsp; contrived internal layouts, poor internal daylighting, to the detriment of the residential amenities of&nbsp;future occupiers. The proposal would therefore be contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D6 of the London Plan (2021), and Policies GR1, GR3A, HO2, of the Harrow&nbsp; Local Plan (2021 - 2041).

<p>The proposal, by reason&nbsp;of failure to provide 35 per cent&nbsp; family sized units with 3 or more bedrooms including the provision of no family units on the ground floor, would result in an inappropriate and
inadequate housing mix,&nbsp;having regard to the location of the site and the
character of its surroundings as well as the evidence of local need which
identifies the need for more larger family sized units, and would fail to
create inclusive and mixed communities&nbsp;contrary to the provisions of the
National Planning Policy Framework (2024), policy H10 of the London Plan (2021) and policies HO1 and HO2 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).</p><p class="MsoNormal"><o:p></o:p></p>
